name: ovms
description: Operations Visual Management System for warehouse planning, decision support and operational execution

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild src/server/apiApp.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; import { fileURLToPath } from 'url'; import path from 'path'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);" --sourcemap --outfile=api/index.js
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.validate:full: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
